Air Traffic Control Technical Issue Causes Flight Disruptions in UK

A technical issue at Prestwick Centre caused widespread flight disruptions across Scotland, Northern Ireland, and northern England. UK transport secretary Heidi Alexander stated the problem has been fixed but warned of potential residual delays as systems reset. The issue was identified as a technical problem affecting NATS air traffic control.
